boxBody: Leave your name and email to join this restaurant's guest club.
welcomeHeadline: Join the Guest Club and get a one-time {{percent}}% discount on the whole bill.
welcomeTerms: The discount is valid for 7 days after you confirm. Show the code to staff before paying. It cannot be combined with other discounts.
welcomeTermsBody: Joining is optional. After you confirm your email you join the club and receive a one-time {{percent}}% discount on the whole bill, valid for 7 days after confirmation. Show the code to staff before paying. It cannot be combined with other discounts and staff apply it manually at the till. It does not apply to later visits. Unsubscribing does not cancel a discount that was already issued and not yet used. Joining again does not give another discount.
terms: I accept the Premium Guest Club terms
marketing: I agree to receive commercial and marketing information by electronic means.
checkBody: We sent you a confirmation link.
checkHint: Tap it to join the Premium Guest Club.
termsBody: Joining is optional. After you confirm your email you join the Premium Guest Club. Every message includes an unsubscribe link that works immediately, without contacting the restaurant. Joining again requires a new email confirmation.
joinedTitle: You’re in the Premium Guest Club.
joinedBody: Your signup is confirmed. You can opt out anytime using the link in the email.
bonusHint: Show this code to staff before paying. It cannot be combined with other discounts.
expiredBody: Submit the form again from the restaurant menu to get a new link.
invalidBody: This link does not work. Open the restaurant menu and join the Premium Guest Club again.
unsubBody: {{email}} will stop receiving messages from {{restaurant}}. The restaurant does not need to approve this.
unsubHint: Opening this page does nothing. You are removed only after you tap the button.
unsubDoneBody: You will no longer receive Premium Guest Club messages. If you change your mind, you can join again from the restaurant menu.
unsubInvalid: This unsubscribe link is invalid. Use the link from the latest message.
